svg.title: UC-P02 - Submit a Private-EV Charging Request

g.text: UC-P02 - Submit a Private-EV Charging Request
Preconditions: Student is signed in and has a parking reservation or session reference.
Service calls use the signed-in Student's identity.
[context unavailable, ineligible, unreadable or Hub unsupported]
No charging request created; parking unchanged.
Use Confirmed parking or an Active session for the same Student, vehicle and Hub.
For Active parking, use the remaining permitted parking interval.
The requested charging window need not use parking time increments.
[eligible context, supported Hub and verified data]
[context invalid, Hub unsupported or data unavailable]
[context or inputs invalid, Hub unsupported or retrieval failed]
Revise inputs or reload eligible parking before a new attempt; no creation.
[Recheck parking and create one linked request]
Check Student, vehicle, Hub, battery values and current parking window.
Serialize with parking cancellation; never leave a live request linked to cancelled parking.
[parking, Hub or inputs no longer eligible]
Busy charging points do not prevent an otherwise valid Pending request.
The scheduler can read the new request; slot assignment is a separate use case.
Parking remains unchanged throughout this use case.
Smart E-Mobility Hub | Submission 2 | Parking & Private EVs
Thin rectangle: execution of a responsibility; nested rectangle: nested execution
Solid arrow: request / action | Dashed arrow: returned result
Activation ends before waiting for Student input. Read guards top to bottom.
critical: required consistency boundary; updates are all-or-none as noted
